name: url-watch
description: Tells you when a web page changes: every 15 minutes it fetches the page, compares it with the last fetch, and notifies you when it differs. Give a pattern to watch one part of the page only, such as a price or a version number.

inputs.label: Only this part
inputs.description: A regular expression: only the first part of the page it matches is compared. Empty compares the whole page.
